day: # The Armenian Apostolic Church's daily Bible readings, by date, for the
# years the Prelacy's calendars give: Advent 2025 (23 November) to 6 January
# 2027 (church years 2025 and 2026, "year eq").  From the Armenian Prelacy
# (Eastern USA), "Daily Bible Readings ... According to the Lectionary of the
# Armenian Apostolic Church", monthly PDFs for November-December 2025
# A day's readings in the order printed, without a title; the services the
# calendar names (Christmas Eve's Divine Liturgy and Dismissal, the Blessing
# of Water, Holy Week's morning and evening offices, the Office of Penitents,
# the Washing of the Feet, the Passion, Crucifixion and Burial, Easter Eve,
# the Blessing of Grapes ...) as sets of their own; in Eastertide the four
# Gospels read through, "1) Morning - Luke; 2) Midday - John; 3) Evening -
# Matthew; 4) Evening dismissal - Mark", each its own set, with the Acts and
# Catholic Epistle at Midday.  Where a saint's day also prints the weekday's
# readings after its Gospel, those are "Daily Readings".  The Armenian Bible's
# own verse numbers are kept (Song of Songs 8:14-26); corrected misprints:

reading: Song of Songs 8:14–26 (with six verses more in the Armenian)
